name: Fast Internet Browser
summary:
Fast Internet Browser is a lightweight web browser for your headset. It opens as a floating panel that you can freely resize — from a compact window up to cinema size.

Browse the flat web, watch videos and manage your tabs in a clean, distraction-free interface. Compatible with Meta Quest.

FEATURES
• Tabs with a smart memory saver
• Built-in blocker for known ad and tracking requests
• Fullscreen video playback
• Pop-up blocker
• Search with DuckDuckGo, Google, Bing or Ecosia
• Bookmarks, history and in-a
